The Program Manager reviews and approves the request, applying least-privilege / need-basis principles. Once approved, the assigned engineer provisions or configures the Communication Plan in the relevant system.
escalation_path: Project Coordinator -> Project Manager -> PMO Lead -> PMO Director

description: Preeti Desai (Administration / Facilities) reported an issue via Walk-in related to: Resource Allocation Request Procedure. Logged against MK-PMTrack.
resolution: Resolved by following SOP-PMO-006. the Project Manager logs into MK-PMTrack and navigates to the 'Resource Request' section. the Project Manager selects 'New Resource Request' and enters the required details, including required skillset, allocation percentage, and duration. the Project Manager attaches any supporting documentation and reviews the entry for accuracy before submitting. the Project Manager submits the Resource Request; MK-PMTrack automatically routes it to the PMO Lead for review.
